extraction.text:
Venkatesh Chavan

Ph: 7019669175 Email Id: Chavan.venkatesh01@gmail.com

Seeking a challenging role in Transaction Banking, Payments Investigations, client services and Settlements, where I can leverage over a decade of experience in banking and financial services. Dedicated to applying innovative management skills, process optimization expertise, and strategic problem-solving abilities to drive operational excellence and organizational growth in a dynamic environment

PROFILE SUMMARY

Experienced Banking & Financial Services professional with 11.5+ years of expertise in Global Payments, Customer Onboarding, Payment Investigations, Transaction Banking, Reconciliation, SWIFT Operations, ISO 20022, Payment Transformation, and Project Delivery across global financial institutions including StoneX Financial, Commercial Bank of Qatar, JP Morgan Chase, Apex Fund Services, and OSFIN.AI.

Demonstrated experience in leading end-to-end transformation initiatives, payment operations migrations, workflow optimization, automation, stakeholder management, business requirement gathering, implementation support, governance, and cross- functional collaboration.

Strong exposure to customer onboarding, payment modernization, workflow orchestration, cross-border payments, regulatory change, operational transformation, project governance, UAT coordination, production deployments, and business process improvements. Proven ability to manage global stakeholders, lead teams of over 40 FTEs, and deliver strategic banking initiatives across Operations, Technology, Product, Compliance, and Business teams.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Program & Project Management • Payments Transformation • Customer Onboarding

Banking Operations Transformation • Workflow Automation • Payment Investigations • Transaction Banking • Target Operating Model (TOM) Support • Business Process Transformation • Stakeholder Management • Cross-functional Leadership • Business Requirement Gathering • BRD Preparation • UAT Coordination • Change Management • Risk & Issue Management • Governance & Executive Reporting • Process Automation • SWIFT • • ACH • Fedwire • CHIPS • SEPA • CHAPS • MT/MX Messaging • Cross-border Payments • Domestic Payments • FX Operations • Reconciliation • Production Release Support ISO 20022

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Manager – Banking Operations

OSFIN.AI | February 2026 – Present

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end implementation projects across Banking Operations and

Reconciliation transformation initiatives.

Manage project lifecycle from planning through execution and closure while

ensuring milestone adherence.

Drive reconciliation automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency. • Partner with Product, Engineering, Business and Implementation teams for successful project delivery.

Develop detailed project plans, resource plans, and implementation schedules. • Coordinate project meetings with internal and external stakeholders. • Track project risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans. • Support banking transformation initiatives through process optimization and operational improvements.

Serve as the primary stakeholder interface throughout project execution.

Relevant Skills

Project Management • Banking Transformation • Workflow Automation • Stakeholder Management • Implementation • Governance • Automation

Offshore Lead – Global Payments

StoneX Financial Ltd | June 2022 – September 2025

Key Responsibilities

Managed end-to-end global payment operations covering domestic and cross-

border payments.

Led multiple payment transformation initiatives and operational improvement

programs.

Managed cross-functional teams across multiple geographies. • Conducted gap analysis and impact assessments for regulatory and product changes.

Gathered business requirements and prepared BRDs for payment enhancements. • Supported UAT execution with business and technology teams.

Worked closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts and Technology teams

throughout the project lifecycle.

Coordinated release planning, production deployments, and post-production

support.

Managed stakeholder communication across Operations, Technology, Compliance

and Business.

Led payment investigations and payment workflow improvements. • Supported ISO 20022 implementation initiatives. • Collaborated with correspondent banks and remitting banks on payment



transformation initiatives. Implemented process improvements through Root Cause Analysis and workflow optimization.

Supported compliance and operational risk initiatives. • Produced project status updates and operational reporting for senior stakeholders.

Key Achievements

Successfully managed migration projects for Payment Investigation and Payment

Settlement functions.

Delivered payment modernization initiatives involving SWIFT and ISO 20022. • • Led strategic payment initiatives across multiple global locations. Improved operational efficiency through automation and workflow optimization.

Relevant Skills

Payments Transformation • Customer Onboarding Support • Workflow Automation • Project Delivery • Stakeholder Management • Requirement Gathering • BRD • UAT • Release Management • ISO 20022 • SWIFT

Senior Associate Level 2 – Transfer Agency

Apex Fund Services LLP | July 2020 – June 2022

Key Responsibilities

Managed operational onboarding activities for investment clients.

Supported client onboarding and account setup activities. • Managed payment processing, reconciliations and settlement activities. • Coordinated AML and KYC documentation review. • Prepared Standard Operating Procedures. • Managed stakeholder communications across internal and external teams. • Supported operational change initiatives. • Handled client-facing operational queries.

Relevant Skills

Client Onboarding • AML • KYC • Payments • Reconciliation • Process Improvement

Payment Processing Associate

Commercial Bank of Qatar | September 2017 – July 2020

Key Responsibilities

Managed end-to-end payment investigations. • Supported Transaction Banking operations. • Worked on SWIFT payment processing. • Participated in migration of Payment Investigation processes from India to Qatar. • Coordinated knowledge transition and cross-functional training. • Worked with Trade Finance and Supply Chain Finance stakeholders. • Managed payment workflow improvements. • Resolved payment exceptions and customer escalations.

Relevant Skills

Payments Transformation • Migration • Stakeholder Management • SWIFT • Transaction Banking

Payment Operations Analyst

JP Morgan Chase Bank | August 2014 – September 2017

Key Responsibilities

Managed payment processing across multiple payment rails. • Supported operational process improvements. • Led training initiatives for new team members. • Worked closely with customer-facing teams for issue resolution. • Managed production support and payment operations. • Conducted Root Cause Analysis for operational issues. • Supported automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency.

TRANSFORMATION EXPERIENCE

Payment Transformation Programs • Banking Operations Transformation • Payment Investigation Migration • Payment Settlement Migration • Workflow Automation • Cross-border Payment Modernization • • SWIFT Modernization • Process Automation • Requirement Gathering • Business Process Optimization • UAT Coordination • Release Management • Stakeholder Governance • Risk Management • Operational Excellence

ISO 20022 Transformation

BANKING DOMAIN EXPERTISE

Transaction Banking • Global Payments • Customer Onboarding

Payment Investigations • Cash Management • Treasury Operations • FX Operations • Settlement Operations • Reconciliation • Payment Processing • Correspondent Banking • Cross-border Payments • Domestic Payments
